summary.en: Violent clashes continue in Port-au-Prince and Kenscoff as Haitian security forces, now reinforced by a Kenya-led multinational mission, confront Viv Ansanm gangs. The Dominican army has supplied large ammunition stocks to the 400 Mawozo gang, increasing its firepower against the security forces. Erik Prince is operating a private mercenary effort targeting the gangs. The United Nations has allocated an additional US$75 million for life-saving aid to 507,000 people and renewed sanctions on Haiti for another year. The conflict caused 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Voldelige sammenstøt fortsetter i Port-au-Prince og Kenscoff mens haitiske sikkerhetsstyrker, nå forsterket av en Kenya-ledet multinasjonal operasjon, konfronterer Viv Ansanm-gjengene. Den dominikanske hæren har levert store ammunisjonslagre til 400‑mannen-sterke Mawozo-gjengen, noe som øker deres ildkraft mot sikkerhetsstyrkene. Erik Prince driver en privat leiesoldatinnsats som retter seg mot gjengene. FN har avsatt ytterligere 75 millioner USD til livreddende hjelp til 507 000 personer og fornyet sanksjoner mot Haiti for ett år til. Konflikten forårsaket 193 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
